description: Three analogue oscillators, each blending between two waveforms, with individual outputs and a summed mix

params.text: Sets the fundamental frequency of that oscillator
Tunes that oscillator finely around the frequency set by its COARSE knob
Sets the depth of linear frequency modulation reaching that oscillator from its LIN FM input
Crossfades oscillator A's output from a sine wave at the left to a triangle wave at the right
Crossfades oscillator A's output from a ramp wave at the left to a square wave at the right
Crossfades oscillator B's output from a sine wave at the left to a square wave at the right
Crossfades oscillator B's output from a triangle wave at the left to a ramp wave at the right
Crossfades oscillator C's output from a sine wave at the left to a ramp wave at the right
Sets the duty cycle of oscillator C's pulse wave, over a range that stays audible without external control voltage
Picks which blend feeds oscillator A's output: sine to triangle in the up position, ramp to square in the down position
Picks which blend feeds oscillator B's output: sine to square in the up position, triangle to ramp in the down position
Picks what oscillator C puts out: a sine to ramp blend in the up position, or a pulse wave with its own PWM control in the down position
Sets how much of that oscillator's selected wave reaches MIX OUT, which sums the three at unity gain and can clip
In the down position the 1V/OCT voltage of oscillator A is normalled to oscillator B, and patching B's own input breaks that normal
In the down position the 1V/OCT voltage of oscillator B is normalled to oscillator C, and patching C's own input breaks that normal

inputs.text: Sets the pitch of that oscillator at a volt per octave, summed with its COARSE and FINE knobs
A rising edge above 2.5V resets that oscillator's cycle
Linear frequency modulation of that oscillator, scaled by the attenuator beside it
Modulates the duty cycle of oscillator C's pulse wave

outputs.text: The wave selected for that oscillator, at the blend set by its crossfader
The three selected waves summed, each at the level set by its own LEVEL knob

inputs.0: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.1: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.2: 1V per octave · continuous · one channel only
inputs.3: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.4: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
inputs.5: high above 2.5V · stepped · one channel only
